_note: The eight earlier messages of one invented conversation (scenario 4). The ninth message is L064 in mail.json: the draft must answer that one only.
subject: Year-end closing 2026 - timeline

messages.body:
Hello Daniel,

we should agree the timeline for the 2026 year-end closing. I propose: stock count by 31 December, last invoices to us by 15 January, draft statements by 28 February.

Kind regards
Agnieszka Lipka

Hello Agnieszka,

the dates work for us. We have no stock, only laptops. Do you need a list of them?

Daniel

Hello Daniel,

yes, please send a list of fixed assets with purchase dates and who uses them. A spreadsheet is fine.

Kind regards
Agnieszka Lipka

Hello Agnieszka,

list attached. Two laptops were sold to employees in June, I marked them.

Daniel

Hello Daniel,

thank you. For the two laptops sold I need the sale invoices or agreements, otherwise they stay in the register.

Kind regards
Agnieszka Lipka

Hello Agnieszka,

agreements attached. Another question: our parent company wants the statements in English as well. Is that possible?

Daniel

Hello Daniel,

the official statements must be in Polish. We can prepare an English reading copy alongside; I will include it in the plan.

Kind regards
Agnieszka Lipka

Hello Agnieszka,

perfect, an English reading copy is all they need. Thank you.

Daniel
